description: This file contains numerous shell functions and scripts related to log collection, backup, transfer, and system state management for a network device. It manages logs for onboard processes, system diagnostics, and remote synchronization, with conditional handling based on device type and configuration.

methods.name: moveFile
methods.description: Moves a file from the first path to the second path if it exists.

methods.name: moveFiles
methods.description: Moves all files from a source folder to a destination folder.

methods.name: createFiles
methods.description: Creates placeholder log files based on the predefined list.

methods.name: createSysDescr
methods.description: Gathers system device information to generate a system descriptor string.

methods.name: flush_atom_logs
methods.description: Flushes logs from the atom device, optionally notifying telemetry.

methods.name: sync_atom_log_files
methods.description: Synchronizes log files from the atom device to a specified destination.

methods.name: syncLogs_nvram2
methods.description: Syncs log files to nvram2 storage, handling different device types and log transfer conditions.

methods.name: backupnvram2logs
methods.description: Backs up current logs and system info into compressed tar files for later retrieval.

methods.name: backupnvram2logs_on_reboot
methods.description: Performs backup of logs upon system reboot, moving files to appropriate directories.

methods.name: rotateLogs
methods.description: Appends current logs to a temporary file and clears the main log file.

methods.name: allFileExists
methods.description: Checks if all predefined log files exist in the source directory.

methods.name: syncLogs
methods.description: Copies logs from the local log directory to nvram or backup paths.

methods.name: logCleanup
methods.description: Removes log files from designated directories.

methods.name: processDCMResponse
methods.description: Processes the DCM response file for log upload configurations.

methods.name: getMaxSize
methods.description: Calculates total size from a list of file sizes.

methods.name: compress_onboard_logs
methods.description: Archives onboard logs into a compressed tar file to save space.

methods.name: upload_onboard_files
methods.description: Uploads onboard log files to a server.

methods.name: copy_onboard_files
methods.description: Copies onboard logs to a backup directory.

methods.name: backup_onboarding_logs
methods.description: Backs up onboard logs, potentially compressing and managing size constraints.

methods.name: copy_onboardlogs
methods.description: Copies onboard logs to specified destination.
